svg.text: 剑影 JIÀNYǏNG · THE WHOLE SYSTEM — PROPOSAL
Supersedes docs/sets.png. Sets are no longer places — they are named forges. The figures are the game's geometry; everything else is proposal.
Three ladders, and only one of them touches the others
This is the answer to "progression and levels". Insight is spent inside one expedition and dies with it. Realm is permanent. A piece of gear has its
own rank — and the rule that binds the system is that a piece can never be tempered above your realm.
Inside one expedition. Buys techniques. Lost at death.
Permanent. Buys attributes — and caps how far steel can be raised.
Per PIECE. Raised at the forge by feeding it duplicates.
Realm 3 → nothing may be tempered past 阶 3
Five forges, and not one of them is a place on the map
Named for the famous swords of legend. A lineage owns one rite, one look and one story. You do not travel to a lineage — you build one, out of what
The town that has forged swords
for a thousand years. Orthodox, and
It leaves an unjust king in
the night, and is found the
One piece, one seal — so every piece is visible
A Chinese painting collects seals down its side: the artist, then every owner. A swordsman collects the seal of every forge they wear. You can count
what somebody is carrying from across the screen, and the rite ignites only when the last seal is stamped.
The forge — where the crafting actually happens
Four operations, and every one of them consumes something the game already produces. No new drop table, and no currency the player has to be taught
One piece, in full — and why two of the same thing are never the same item
干将 Lamellar Skirt · 阶 4 · Rare · sockets 2 · 焰 Ember, 霜 Frost
形 the shape comes from the base · 谱 the lineage stamps the seal and owns the rite · 阶 the rank marks the hems and cords · 铭 the sockets carry what you cut
Four axes. The one architectural cost in all of this is that an owned item stops being a bare id in the save and becomes an instance with a rank and sockets.
